categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: engineering services including mechanical, electrical, and environmental engineering; real estate development focusing on residential and industrial buildings; optoelectronics manufacturing producing LED components and LCM modules; and industrial park development involving land acquisition, planning, and construction management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Engineering projects utilize integrated turnkey solutions combining design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Real estate development emphasizes sustainable, green, and smart building designs with collaboration from renowned architects. Optoelectronics production involves advanced LED packaging and LCM assembly processes, including TFT display modules. Industrial park development integrates land acquisition, planning, marketing, and construction oversight with government cooperation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies for public infrastructure projects, private enterprises for industrial and commercial construction, domestic and international clients for optoelectronics products, and local governments and industries for industrial park development. The real estate segment targets end consumers mainly in metropolitan areas like Taipei and New Taipei City.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with major projects and developments in regions such as Chiayi County, Tainan City, Taipei, and New Taipei City. The optoelectronics segment serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 70% of sales exported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments: it acts as an integrator and contractor in engineering and construction, a developer and seller in real estate, a manufacturer and supplier in optoelectronics, and a developer and manager in industrial park projects. It sources materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products and services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing integrated engineering capabilities, expanding sustainable and smart building projects, innovating optoelectronics products with improved performance and cost efficiency, and growing industrial park development projects aligned with government policies. R&D focuses on advanced construction technologies, new display modules, TFT backlight improvements, and compliance with environmental and sustainability standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based engineering and construction contracts, real estate sales and leasing, manufacturing and sales of optoelectronics components and modules, and land development and sales in industrial parks. The company also earns income from consulting and integrated service provision.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In engineering and construction, the company competes with both domestic and international firms, leveraging its integrated mechanical-electrical-construction expertise and partnerships with global engineering companies. In real estate, it faces competition from established developers in metropolitan areas. The optoelectronics segment competes in a highly competitive market with many players, focusing on niche and mid-size display modules. In industrial park development, it competes with experienced developers like Dechang and Liming, emphasizing government collaboration and regional expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.66 billion in 2023, with a net profit of about NT$203 million and earnings per share of NT$0.98. While revenue decreased compared to the previous year, profitability remained stable. The company has a total asset base exceeding NT$10 billion and equity of about NT$3.49 billion, showing steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated turnkey engineering services combining mechanical, electrical, and construction expertise to deliver high-quality, cost-effective projects. Its real estate developments focus on sustainable, green, and smart building designs with strong architectural credentials. In optoelectronics, it offers diverse, energy-efficient display modules tailored to customer needs. Industrial park development leverages government partnerships and regional insights to provide optimized land and facility solutions, positioning itself as a reliable, innovative, and customer-oriented service provider.
